name: Curvature-Constrained 2D Gradient Estimation
definition: A refinement of 2D gradient estimation that restricts normal computation to pixels within the same continuous curvature region to prevent blurring across disjoint object boundaries.
summary: Curvature-Constrained 2D Gradient Estimation computes surface normals by restricting calculations to pixels within the same continuous curvature region, preventing the blurring of sharp features across disjoint object boundaries.
